verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a first-party plugin system. Functions are 'modular Python plugins' that can add models or intercept messages, and Tools, Functions, Pipes, Filters and Pipelines all run Python on your own self-hosted server. Skills are also documented as a folder with a SKILL.md file, and the project publishes per-version plugin-API migration guides for breaking releases. Missing for 10: step-by-step evidence of how a custom plugin is uploaded or registered into an instance, detailed format/schema reference content in the pack, and independent hands-on corroboration of authoring and loading a custom plugin.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write my own skill, tool, or plugin against a documented format and load it into my instance locally

citations.quote: Functions are modular Python plugins that extend the capabilities of Open WebUI itself.
Tools, Functions, Pipes, Filters, and Pipelines execute arbitrary Python code on your server.
A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file: a reusable instruction set the AI can pull in on demand
Extend with Python. Share what you build, run what others share.
